note: State forest campground on the Manistique River near Gulliver, run by Schoolcraft County; gravel access road. Best for smaller rigs. --Claude
summary: DNR page (a stub: manager, phone, '10 sites for tent and trailer use') + SF amenity table ($20, 10 sites, boat ramp, not on MiDNRReservations, season 'contact manager'): count 10 and $20 confirmed. The DNR page carries none of the usual state forest boilerplate, so hookups, facilities, FCFS and the inherited 15-night maximum are left as they were (derived/inherited, unconfirmed). Type 'rustic', ORV operation 'no'; no equestrian wording. No Schoolcraft County campground page found. flags: Missing phone: the DNR page gives 906-341-3618 and says 'Merwin Creek State Forest Campground is under the management of Schoolcraft County. Any concerns or questions about this campground should be directed to the County at the phone number identified above.'
